card.name: Dose wording before daily or time-of-day
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions just before a daily frequency or time of day, such as 'twice', 'doses', 'tablet' or 'at' ahead of 'daily', 'morning' or 'bedtime'.

modes.label: Frequency before daily
modes.description: Count or unit words like twice, tablet, drop or doses that come right before 'daily' or 'once daily'.
modes.example: 1,000 mg/m 2 orally<< twice>> daily for the first 14 days

modes.label: Time-of-day lead-in
modes.description: Small words that introduce a time of day for taking the dose, like morning, evening or bedtime.
modes.example: usually in<< the>> morning. The recommended dose of paroxetine

card.writes: It pushes the model toward time-of-day words such as afternoon and morning.
card.plain: It fires in dosing directions at the word just before 'daily' or a time of day is expected.
